description: This file implements autolink parsing functions for markdown processing, including URL and www link detection, domain validation, and punctuation trimming.

methods.name: parseWWWAutolink
methods.description: Parses a string to identify a www link starting at a given position.

methods.name: parseURLAutolink
methods.description: Parses a string to identify a URL starting at a given position.

methods.name: isSchemeAllowed
methods.description: Checks if a URL scheme is in the list of allowed schemes.

methods.name: checkDomain
methods.description: Validates and returns the length of a domain name within a URL.

methods.name: isValidHostCharacter
methods.description: Determines if a character is valid in a URL host.

methods.name: trimTrailingCharactersFromLink
methods.description: Removes trailing punctuation and brackets from a link.

methods.name: canEndAutolink
methods.description: Checks if a character can be the end of an autolink.
